scripts.version:patch: node -e "const pkg=require('./package.json'); const [major,minor,patch]=pkg.version.split('.').map(Number); const newVer=`${major}.${minor}.${patch+1}`; require('child_process').execSync(`node update-version.js ${newVer}`, {stdio:'inherit'});"
scripts.version:minor: node -e "const pkg=require('./package.json'); const [major,minor,patch]=pkg.version.split('.').map(Number); const newVer=`${major}.${minor+1}.0`; require('child_process').execSync(`node update-version.js ${newVer}`, {stdio:'inherit'});"
scripts.version:major: node -e "const pkg=require('./package.json'); const [major,minor,patch]=pkg.version.split('.').map(Number); const newVer=`${major+1}.0.0`; require('child_process').execSync(`node update-version.js ${newVer}`, {stdio:'inherit'});"
scripts.test:mobile: echo 'Testing mobile responsiveness - use browser dev tools to simulate mobile devices'
